status: PROVISIONAL — NOT GOVERNING. Built from the Gate 3A round-11 review candidate, which is not cleared. No classification here is asserted; every §14C judgement is PENDING.
spec: Zugrio Signal Authority Architecture v1.0.2 — §14A (consumer map), §14B (state-policy decomposition), §14C (hard-predicate admissibility)
knownGap: Gate 3A inventories authority sinks only. §14A also requires trade-plan presentation and research-logging consumers; those are not yet in this map.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current browser-side cTrader route environment/connection/armed/mode checks.
fields.thresholdSource: Execution/configuration/security policy, not signal quality.
fields.intendedDestination: Gate-4 EXECUTION_POLICY_ADMITTED / Broker Execution Policy. Failure locks execution but must not demote a valid conviction state.

fields.semanticMeaning: Identity and direction of the order the browser submits to /api/broker/*: instrument, side, entry price, event/candidate/position identifiers, source timeframe, signal time, model and family labels and the data-quality label. Stop and take-profit values are classified as STOP_GEOMETRY / TARGET_GEOMETRY.
fields.thresholdSource: Copied from the fired signal record / managed position; no thresholds.
fields.intendedDestination: Gate-4 broker intent contract / ExecutionSnapshot: replace with a typed, hashed order payload whose every field has declared provenance.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current browser boundary that submits entry, reversal-exit or manual-close instructions to /api/broker/*.
fields.thresholdSource: Transport/submission action; not signal quality or eligibility.
fields.intendedDestination: Gate-4 Broker Execution Boundary with deterministic intent identity, idempotency, reconciliation and scoped execution admission.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current calibration/trade-permission fields copied into browser execution intents.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy calibration/permission contract.
fields.intendedDestination: Replace with scoped INFERENCE_ADMITTED/STATE_POLICY_ADMITTED/EXECUTION_POLICY_ADMITTED provenance; no status string grants execution.

fields.semanticMeaning: Canonical Gate-2 ATR availability check.
fields.thresholdSource: W=200 canonical-history requirement frozen by Gate 2; failure is data insufficiency independent of profitability.
fields.intendedDestination: Layer-1 data-validity predicate/reason code.

fields.semanticMeaning: knownAt/triggerAt recency currently used in selection.
fields.thresholdSource: Deterministic tie-break semantics.
fields.intendedDestination: Candidate Selection Policy final tie-break only after conviction/setup priority.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current advisory-only data-health observations/reasons that are intentionally not execution-critical.
fields.thresholdSource: Diagnostic/advisory semantics; no capital authority.
fields.intendedDestination: advisoryFeatureSchema and diagnostics only; structurally unreachable from pWin/EV/state authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: Composite feed/data-health verdict used by the live profile engine.
fields.thresholdSource: Current feedGate contains minimum-bar, age, continuity, ATR-availability and tick-recency thresholds. Those constituent thresholds must be recorded individually before §14C admission.
fields.intendedDestination: Decompose into named Layer-1 data-validity predicates. Until constituent provenance is complete, DATA_HEALTH_OK is not admitted as 2B authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: Composite reason/blocker array from feedGate.
fields.thresholdSource: Mixed thresholds inherited from feedGate.
fields.intendedDestination: Replace with named Layer-1 reason codes emitted by individual admitted predicates.

fields.semanticMeaning: Candidate/event has already been consumed/recorded.
fields.thresholdSource: Identity/idempotency safety condition; no outcome optimization.
fields.intendedDestination: Identity/dedup safety predicate; final broker idempotency belongs Gate 4/Boundary.

fields.semanticMeaning: Proposed FIRE-entry-event boolean; it does not yet exist as an admitted predicate.
fields.thresholdSource: UNDECLARED. The current assessTrigger/lifecycle thresholds cannot be renamed into authority.
fields.intendedDestination: Do not create in production until its closed-bar definition and every threshold provenance are frozen and pass HP-1/HP-2.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current entry-extension thresholds relative to ATR/reference.
fields.thresholdSource: 0.35 ATR and continuation-extension limits are reference policy values requiring provenance/validation.
fields.intendedDestination: Dynamic execution/State Policy feature or Gate-4 veto as appropriate; not silently structural.

fields.semanticMeaning: Per-profile signal cooldown.
fields.thresholdSource: Policy duration, not structural validity.
fields.intendedDestination: Broker/Execution Policy if retained and validated; not candidate/state authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: family.demoExecutionAllowed / broker-model availability gate.
fields.thresholdSource: Product/adapter permission, not market structure.
fields.intendedDestination: Gate-4 execution/entitlement admission. Must not alter valid conviction state.

fields.semanticMeaning: Proposed completeness/coherence predicate for frozen trade geometry.
fields.thresholdSource: Structural completeness concept is non-P/L, but the current plan object also mixes economics. Exact constituent definition still requires separation/provenance.
fields.intendedDestination: Layer-1 named predicate only after structural-only definition is extracted from planner economics.

fields.semanticMeaning: Directional context quality: same/opposing votes and derived context.ok.
fields.thresholdSource: Current same>=1 && opposing<2 rule has no recorded non-P/L derivation.
fields.intendedDestination: Capital feature(s), not direct 2B gate. This is the semantic successor of HTF_GRADE_NOT_C unless later proven structural under §14C.

fields.semanticMeaning: evaluateStrategy direction output/strategyPreview.direction.
fields.thresholdSource: Derived from current legacy evaluation semantics.
fields.intendedDestination: Map to explicit candidate direction/feature semantics; never use as hidden state authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: evaln broad/execution/actionable family counts.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy evidence-count heuristics.
fields.intendedDestination: Feature vector/diagnostics only unless a later validated model uses them.

fields.semanticMeaning: evaln.primarySetupQualified alters legacy READY/FIRE thresholds.
fields.thresholdSource: Current stage-membership shortcut has no independent safety justification.
fields.intendedDestination: Remove threshold-shortcut authority. Candidate lifecycle is handled explicitly in Layer 1.

fields.semanticMeaning: evaln.riskScale.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy/profile sizing heuristic.
fields.intendedDestination: Gate-4 Risk/Sizing Policy.

fields.semanticMeaning: evaluateStrategy/evaln score.
fields.thresholdSource: Weighted legacy strategy components; not calibrated.
fields.intendedDestination: capitalFeatureSchema only if retained; all direct state/data-request thresholds removed.

fields.semanticMeaning: evaln.specialistQualified/specialistGate composite.
fields.thresholdSource: Mixed specialist heuristics and data/safety rules.
fields.intendedDestination: Decompose into named safety predicates and features; no composite state authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: evaln.thesisId consistency checks.
fields.thresholdSource: Identity consistency rather than profitability, but currently bound to legacy evaluation object.
fields.intendedDestination: Replace with deterministic candidate/setup identity in FrozenTradeGeometry.

fields.semanticMeaning: Legacy execution intent fields such as riskCanOpen:true / executionPermission:DEMO_AUTO that assert permission inside the payload.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy browser intent convention; no scoped provenance proof.
fields.intendedDestination: Remove. Execution permission comes only from scoped provenance plus Gate-4 veto/broker policy; payload strings/booleans never grant capital authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current rank(c) of TRIGGERED/RETEST/BREAK states.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy selection policy.
fields.intendedDestination: Candidate Selection Policy; no current lifecycle rank may suppress a distinct candidate before inference.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current BREAK_CONFIRMED/RETEST_TOUCHED/RETEST_HELD/TRIGGERED lifecycle stage and its thresholds.
fields.thresholdSource: Stage transitions include 5-bar expiry and continuation/rejection thresholds that require provenance review.
fields.intendedDestination: Replace with frozen Layer-1 lifecycle ending in LIFECYCLE_CONFIRMED; Layer 1 no longer emits TRIGGERED.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current user-confirmed direct close-position path exposed by the browser broker integration.
fields.thresholdSource: User request plus broker position identifier; current browser path is not the frozen reduced safety kernel.
fields.intendedDestination: Gate-4/Position Management reduced safety path: verified POSITION_IDENTITY + REDUCTION_PROOF + BROKER_REACHABILITY, without risk-increasing side effects.

fields.semanticMeaning: Venue/session is open for the relevant market.
fields.thresholdSource: Market schedule/execution feasibility, independent of profitability.
fields.intendedDestination: Execution-feasibility predicate/reason code; venue-specific adapter ultimately owns authoritative schedule.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current continuous score used by live/legacy presentation and some legacy/data-acquisition logic.
fields.thresholdSource: Engineering weights/thresholds; not calibrated pWin/EV.
fields.intendedDestination: Remove as authority. Selection uses conviction state→pWin→EV→setup priority→causal age; presentation may show non-authoritative diagnostics.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current opposing-FIRE demotion based partly on context.same.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy conflict policy.
fields.intendedDestination: Execution exposure/conflict policy; candidate states remain individually preserved.

fields.semanticMeaning: reasonTree.blockers/reasons array from current plan.
fields.thresholdSource: Mixed structural/economic thresholds.
fields.intendedDestination: Split into named Layer-1 structural reason codes and Gate-4 economic veto reasons.

fields.semanticMeaning: plannerStatus/executionEligible composite mixes structural geometry and economics.
fields.thresholdSource: Mixed.
fields.intendedDestination: Split structural geometry completeness from dynamic execution economics. No composite plan verdict survives.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current automated opposite-structure exit gate over managed positions.
fields.thresholdSource: Mixed lifecycle/context/specialist/freshness conditions.
fields.intendedDestination: Versioned Position Management Policy plus emergency risk-reduction kernel; classify actual effect as RISK_REDUCING/RISK_INCREASING.

fields.semanticMeaning: Executable analysis price must be finite and positive.
fields.thresholdSource: Numeric/domain validity only; no outcome optimization.
fields.intendedDestination: Layer-1 data-validity predicate. Implementation note: the admitted predicate's live authority consumer is the inline finite/positive price check in analyze(). The separately named `priceValid` write in finalizeOutcome() is dispositioned LOGGING_OUTCOME_ONLY and is not this predicate's implementation; do not read the logging write as the predicate, and do not promote it to authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: Which user-selected/managed profile lanes are eligible to enter the live lane pool.
fields.thresholdSource: User/product configuration, not signal quality.
fields.intendedDestination: Candidate Selection Policy input/configuration. It may define lane scope but must not impersonate conviction.

fields.semanticMeaning: Canonical regime confidence/quality quantities used by legacy gates.
fields.thresholdSource: Historical confidence thresholds are priors without validation artifact.
fields.intendedDestination: capitalFeatureSchema/diagnostics only; no raw regime-confidence state gate.

fields.semanticMeaning: Continuation OBSERVE route / researchSeeds.
fields.thresholdSource: Research priors only.
fields.intendedDestination: Research ledger only; unreachable from production candidate/state authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: Gross R, net R, cost R and profile economics currently mixed into plan validity/state.
fields.thresholdSource: minGrossR/minNetR/maxCostR are profile economic policy values, not structural validity.
fields.intendedDestination: Remove from Layer-1/state eligibility. Economics move to ExecutionSnapshot + Gate-4 veto/policy; any model use is feature-only.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current reversal-exit intent hardcodes dataExecutionOk:true instead of expressing risk-reducing classification directly.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy exit-intent convention; not a data-health proof.
fields.intendedDestination: Replace with explicit RISK_REDUCING order classification and reduced safety invariant set; do not spoof data health to obtain permission.

fields.semanticMeaning: Profile/specialist risk scaling currently produced before canonical sizing.
fields.thresholdSource: Sizing policy values; not Layer-1 validity.
fields.intendedDestination: Gate-4 Risk/Sizing Policy only. No Layer-1 or conviction authority.

fields.semanticMeaning: Composite market-family specialist reasons/alignment/bias gate.
fields.thresholdSource: Mix of safety/data conditions and heuristic directional filters.
fields.intendedDestination: Decompose per market family: safety/data predicates may pass §14C; heuristic terms become capital/advisory features.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current state-based ranking of lanes/candidates.
fields.thresholdSource: Deterministic ranking policy.
fields.intendedDestination: Candidate Selection Policy with version/hash; current ranking replaced by frozen §6.6 ordering.

fields.semanticMeaning: Stop side/distance/volatility-floor/width checks.
fields.thresholdSource: Some checks are structural; ATR multipliers/limits require provenance separation from optimized policy.
fields.intendedDestination: Structural stop-side/completeness may become Layer-1 predicates; economic width limits belong later unless independently safety-derived.

fields.semanticMeaning: Existence/ordering of a credible target.
fields.thresholdSource: Structural target existence is non-P/L; target-selection policy is separately versioned.
fields.intendedDestination: Layer-1 geometry completeness only after separation from minimum-R economics.

fields.semanticMeaning: Execution-tick recency checks.
fields.thresholdSource: 15s and clock-skew values are execution/data-safety thresholds requiring recorded provenance.
fields.intendedDestination: Named data/execution-safety predicate; Gate-4 final price freshness uses pinned snapshots.

fields.semanticMeaning: Current triggerFresh/triggerAt recency gates.
fields.thresholdSource: Current max 120s / 1.5× execution timeframe rule has no recorded §14C provenance.
fields.intendedDestination: Re-express as named freshness predicate only after provenance; FIRE freshness ultimately belongs to State Policy.

fields.semanticMeaning: Legacy weighted/fresh trigger semantics and confirmation components.
fields.thresholdSource: Legacy trigger thresholds/weights have incomplete or outcome-adjacent provenance.
fields.intendedDestination: Decompose. Continuous pieces become capital features; a future ENTRY_EVENT_CONFIRMED is created only after every constituent passes §14C.
